metrics_finding.finding: The CPU utilization of the auth-service increased from 0.05554% to 0.03103% during the failure window, indicating a potential decrease in CPU load.

evidence_summary.summary: The CPU utilization of the auth-service decreased from 0.05554% to 0.03103% during the failure window, indicating a potential decrease in CPU load.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor CPU utilization of the auth-service closely and consider adjusting resource allocation if necessary.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be a decrease in CPU load on the auth-service, which may have been caused by a reduction in system load. Further investigation is required to confirm this.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण विश्वसनीयता स्तर 0.35 पर पाया गया है कि ऑथेंटिक सेवा में सीपीयू लोड कम हो सकता है, जो शायद सिस्टम लोड की कमी के कारण हो सकता है। आगे की जांच आवश्यक है ताकि यह पुष्टि की जा सके।
